description: This Java source file defines the AmqpContext class, which encapsulates context information used by the AMQP Adapter in the Eclipse Hono project for handling messages sent by client devices. It includes methods for creating context from messages, accessing message properties, and managing tracing and timing information.

classes.name: AmqpContext
classes.description: A class that contains context information used by the AMQP Adapter when uploading messages to Hono, including message details, device info, timing, and tracing data.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an AmqpContext instance from a ProtonDelivery, Message, and Device, initializing context fields based on the message.

methods.name: getMessagePayload
methods.description: Returns the body of the AMQP message as a Buffer.

methods.name: getPayloadSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the message payload in bytes.

methods.name: getMessageContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the AMQP message.

methods.name: delivery
methods.description: Returns the ProtonDelivery object associated with this context.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint type targeted by the message.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns the resource identifier address of the message.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedDevice
methods.description: Returns the device that authenticated via SASL, or null if unauthenticated.

methods.name: isDeviceAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if the device is authenticated.

methods.name: isRemotelySettled
methods.description: Indicates if the delivery was settled by the device.

methods.name: setTimer
methods.description: Sets the timer object for measuring processing duration.

methods.name: getTraceSamplingPriority
methods.description: Gets the optional trace sampling priority for OpenTracing spans.

methods.name: setTraceSamplingPriority
methods.description: Sets the trace sampling priority for OpenTracing spans.
